title: Best practical Ds solver with theorem-backed certificate
statement: Synthesize efficient-score upper optimization, inductive fitting, exact Ds exchange refinement, held-out evaluation, and upper-bound gap reporting under the audited DS17 constraints. On the scalar population-conditionally-centered class (L), the full (M2)+(M3)+(M5) ordinary-stable class is eventually empty, so any margin-constrained output must be reported as constrained, priced by v_hat_K - Phi_hat_s, and non-inductive; the established compile route is the projected efficient-score interval rule with its DP ceiling. Off (L), a solver may use the fixed-point root equation only as a necessary population diagnostic. The measured mix3 root motivates OP29(a), but cheap certification, root uniqueness, and empirical basin transfer are unproved.
